title: AI Cutout Animation Generator
summary: Make cutout animation with AI. Describe the scene, pick a paper style, and Flick makes jointed paper puppets, layered card sets and silhouette shadow plays.
body_markdown:
### How do I make cutout animation with AI?


Describe a scene built from cut paper, naming the paper, the joints and the layers, such as a fox puppet of textured card with brass fasteners in a layered paper forest, pick a paper style, and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### What is paper cutout animation?


Paper cutout animation is cutout animation made from paper alone: construction paper, card or painted sheets, cut with scissors or torn, layered for depth and lit from above or behind.


### Can I make a cutout animation video, not just an image?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, and describe stepped, jointed motion, such as the fox's legs swinging at the pins or the layers sliding past each other.


### What is the difference between cutout animation and silhouette animation?


Silhouette animation is a kind of cutout animation that uses black cutouts against a lit background, so the outline carries the whole picture, while other cutout styles show the colour, texture and print of the paper.


### Is the cutout animation generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
